=General Script Information=

When the wearer is hit, the armor has a chance to unleash Animalistic Instinct, which can knockdown the attacker and disorient them momentarily.
If used with an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, there is a chance the armor will call for aid and also add the weapon/shield's Animalistic Fury flares to the response.

As well, each spirit type only has certain pre-approved nouns allowed.

--LOOK AT ME JEWELRY--
~General Script Information~
This is special jewelry that indicates more precise locations of where and how it is being worn in messaging.
It can have a separate description when it is worn, allowing more flexibility in how it looks.

Each type of jewelry can only be set to specific positions.
Jewelry can have "sides" unlocked to store more designs/specific positions.

This ring currently has access to 1 side.
~Alteration Guidelines~
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this item can be freely altered.
* This item can have separate descriptions when being worn, as well as when being held.

Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

Welcome to the one, the only, and the never-before-seen "Paint-in-ator 3000"!

This incredible, amazing, and often underestimated item will thrill you with its ability to store paint.  That's right, Brodega!  It stores paint!  If you aren't sure what to do with paint, then you clearly do not understand the physical strain of a crafter!
Instructions:
1. Hold your paint in hand
2. POUR your paint IN the Paint-in-ator 3000
3. Marvel at the relief to your shoulders as you shed weight
4. GAZE at your Paint-in-ator 3000 to see all the stored paints
Retrieval Instructions:
1. PUSH a crystal amulet (or any of its cousins) into the Paint-in-ator.  (she's a hungry beast!)

3. SPIN the Paint-in-ator to cycle through all the stored paint (50 is max)
4. NUDGE the Paint-in-ator to cycle between paintstick and vial options
5. TURN the Paint-in-ator to collect your paint or paintstick
Please note, any paints poured into the "Paint-in-ator 3000" are consumed by it and can only be retrieved using the methods listed above.
That's right, Brodega, it is that simple!

The Paint-in-ator has the following commands: gaze (displays all stored paint), nudge (cycles between paint and paintstick options), poke (turns on/off third person messaging for spin & tap), pour (adds paint to the device), prod (turns on/off long analyze), pull (removes crystal amulet from the device), push (adds crystal amulet to device), spin (cycles through available paint), tap (cycles through doses to create), turn (provides paint), and whisper (jumps to paint #)

These warnings only apply to the 'fullness' of chrisms and none of their other qualities.

You can POUR the chrismarium on a player to grant them its effects, provided you are skilled in using chrisms.  You can also POUR it on the ground, which wastes a charge but may be useful if you want to replace the contents with higher-quality chrisms.

Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

This is a chrismarium, a holy relic that stores the oil and balsam from inside a chrism gem, allowing you to stockpile multiple charges inside for later application to a corpse.  While anyone may add chrism oil to it, it may only be used by clerics to apply the chrism effect.
It may be altered but must remain made of metal, and the noun must remain chrismarium.
This chrismarium is at tier 2 out of 5.  A skilled merchant might be able to unlock it further.
It will hold a maximum of 40 charges.
It is currently using the "Standard" messaging style.

You can PUSH the chrismarium with a chrism in your other hand to store it within.  This destroys the chrism and adds one charge to the chrismarium.  The charges within the chrismarium are as effective as the average of all chrism gems absorbed in this fashion.
You can PROD the chrismarium to stop being warned about when chrism's quality would reduce the average of the chrismarium's contents.
These warnings only apply to the 'fullness' of chrisms and none of their other qualities.

You can POUR the chrismarium on a player to grant them its effects, provided you are skilled in using chrisms.  You can also POUR it on the ground, which wastes a charge but may be useful if you want to replace the contents with higher-quality chrisms.
Unlocked verbs: PUSH, POUR, LOOK, MEASURE, RUB, PROD, PONDER

This is a scarring razor.  It can be used to scar yourself or another who is joined to you.  Scarring razors require some first aid training to use, the better you are, the more efficient you'll be.  The razor must be cleansed and sharpened to get the most of out the item, but over time, the razor will break apart, unless you obtain a special one that will never dull.

Scars will go in the distinguishing mark area of your features, and are permanent.  You will be prompted as to what it will replace.  If something is temporarily altering your features, you will need to remove or stop whatever it is before being scarred.  There is a short cooldown period in between uses to prevent overzealous scarring.
Scar Selection:

To choose how you scar, you must PUSH to select what you'd like to change and PULL to cycle through the choices available.  Custom scars are possible to get from a merchant who can work on the razors.  To select a custom scar, you'd need to TURN the razor.
Scarring Yourself:
In order to scar yourself, you just need to POINT it at yourself.
Scarring Others:
To scar others, they must be following you.  Once grouped, you simply POINT the razor at them and they will need to APPROVE it.  Once approved, they will be scarred.
Razor Maintenance:
Razors need to be cleansed after they are used, and sharpened when they start to dull.  There are several different ways to clean the razor.  Some come with other effects.
The invar razor will cost 4,000,000 coins.

Tiny caterpillars are embroidered along the edges of the greatcloak.  The greatcloak's interior has several pockets, ties, and straps to hide items away.
It is estimated that a ruffle-wing moth greatcloak of peacock blue spidersilk can store an exceptional amount with enough space for any number of items.
The greatcloak can be worn, hanging it from the shoulders.  The greatcloak appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of cloth, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a ruffle-wing moth greatcloak of peacock blue spidersilk indicates the creator has provided the following information:
~*~ Moth Cloaks ~*~

This greatcloak is a butterfly/moth cloak with several randomizing points to create multiple unique looks with a single PUSH.  It is Tier 5 out of 5, it has has the "side-unlock" for a temp feature alter + choosing your color, and it is set to the moth setting.  It is set to NOT rotate with day/night changes.  You can APPROVE to toggle this setting.
The greatcloak features an encumbrance reduction (3x/day, 15 minutes each RUB, resets at midnight server time.  There are 3 charges left today.
Utilities:
* APPROVE:  rotates through "moth only," "butterfly only," or "adjust with day/night"
* ATTEND - shows the temporary feature options
* CLEAN:  will clear the selected, stored look
* FIDGET - shows the colors available to permanently set for the forewings on randomized looks
* POKE: takes your randomized look and saves it in 1 of the 2 available stored slots
* PUSH - replaces your randomized look
* TURN - rotates through all saved looks (current randomized look, any stored randomized looks, the custom look, if applicable)
* RUB - activates the encumbrance reduction.
* WHISPER - allows you to set the temporary feature option and the forewing color
Unlocked Fluff Verbs:  observe, tickle, eat, flip, hug, raise, bow, curtsy, brush, touch, and wave
*  WAVE has some "drama llama" options for you!  Try WAVE CLOAK WITH (anger, drama, joy, mystery, or sorrow)
Alterations:
* Base:  must be simple, as it carries across all looks.  The noun must be in the hooded cloak family.
* Material:  must be a type of cloth.  This carries across all looks.
* Colors cannot be referenced in the base or material fields, as colors change based on the settings.
* Custom settings:  The alter points must be provided in this specific order:

** "butterfly adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing markinglocation^special*moth adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing marking location^special
** The total character count must be 511 or less
** Moth/Butterfly Adjective alter point must be 15 characters or less.  No a/an needed.
** See the wiki for in-depth information and examples at https://gswiki.play.net/Moth_Cloak
* Custom Look 1 (Butterfly):  You can provide a SHOW for your custom setting.  It cannot contradict the alter points selected for the custom settings.
* Custom Look 2 (Moth):  Same as butterfly, but for the moth version.

* Doing a custom setting is 1 alteration service, as is each custom look (so a custom setting, butterfly look, and moth look are 3 separate alterations.  This is because each one is fairly intricate).
* The base/material can be done by a merchant separately or at the same time as one of the custom alterations.
*  It is up to the individual merchant if they wish to work on these items.
Current Settings:

flashy^crescent-wing^violet^whorls^moss green^tipping the far edge of the^deep red^spots^zaffre^gracing the^Tiny constellations are embroidered along the greatcloak's hood.*opalescent^ruffle-wing^peacock blue^dagger markings^turquoise^along the inside of the^silver-green^stippling^olive green^encircling the^Tiny caterpillars are embroidered along the edges of the greatcloak.
~*~End Custom Analyze~*~

Analysis of a reinforced invar razor indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a scarring razor.  It can be used to scar yourself or another who is joined to you.  Scarring razors require some first aid training to use, the better you are, the more efficient you'll be.  The razor must be cleansed and sharpened to get the most of out the item, but over time, the razor will break apart, unless you obtain a special one that will never dull.

Scars will go in the distinguishing mark area of your features, and are permanent.  You will be prompted as to what it will replace.  If something is temporarily altering your features, you will need to remove or stop whatever it is before being scarred.  There is a short cooldown period in between uses to prevent overzealous scarring.
Scar Selection:

To choose how you scar, you must PUSH to select what you'd like to change and PULL to cycle through the choices available.  Custom scars are possible to get from a merchant who can work on the razors.  To select a custom scar, you'd need to TURN the razor.
Scarring Yourself:
In order to scar yourself, you just need to POINT it at yourself.
Scarring Others:
To scar others, they must be following you.  Once grouped, you simply POINT the razor at them and they will need to APPROVE it.  Once approved, they will be scarred.
Razor Maintenance:
Razors need to be cleansed after they are used, and sharpened when they start to dull.  There are several different ways to clean the razor.  Some come with other effects.
The invar razor will cost 250,000 coins.

Analysis of a small wicker basket indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the Basketifier, straight out of the shop Preserving Breads at Evermore Hollow!
This basket is designed to hold food items for you.  It will keep them fresh and unlimited until you decide to remove them.
It is currently tier 4 of 4, which means it will house 24 food items.
To use the basket, simply follow these steps:
1. PUT - use this to add food items to the basket.
2. RUB - use this to prepare a food item for removal.
3. TURN - Use this to remove a food item from the basket.  (must be charged with a small statue)
To create a picnic, follow these steps:
1. PULL - to pull the blanket out.  This will move all food to the blanket, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. PUSH - to clean up the picnic.  This will move all food and the blanket back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The picnic will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
To create a table, follow these steps:
1. PROD - to set the table out.  This will move all food items onto the table, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. TINKER - to clean up the table.  This will move all food back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The table will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
A small wicker basket has 1 charges stored in it that can be used to remove food.
Alterations:
The basket may be altered freely, but it must remain a basket.  It can have a long or show description.
Basket's Blanket: a fringed red and black cloth
It must maintain a noun of blanket, cloth, tablecloth, or something similar.  It may have a long or a show description and must be made of fabric.
Table Base: a rough oak table
The table must keep the noun table.  It may have a long or a show description and needs to be made of wood.
Customizing food in the basket is a special, delayed service.
The wicker basket will cost 4,000,000 coins.

The glaes jar will cost 100,000 coins.

Teras Isle.name: an asymmetrical dark green jewel striated by gold inclusions

raw: A mirage-like haze of arcane influence clings to the jewel, alight with half-glimpsed glyphs refracting across its facets from within.  The effect is dizzying and makes further visual inspection difficult.
The jewel appears to be a powerful relic that can convey wondrous abilities on its wielder.  It has the following property:
Rarity:      Common
Mnemonic:    cuttingcorners
Description: Bounties with repetitions will be given with 1d3 fewer repetitions required.

You note the telltale filaments of a lesser binding shimmering around the dark green jewel.  You can sense that the jewel is bound to Yakushi, but a sufficiently skilled artificer should be able to dispel the binding.
The jewel can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of gemstone, an extremely common material.
The dark green jewel will cost 1,555,555 coins.

Welcome to Aelotoi Wing Jewels, designed by and made for Aelotoi.  This specially made item can be worn on Aelotoi wings.  You can change the way that they are worn by using FLIP to cycle through the style options.
The current style of a series of verdigris hoops trailing amber beads will change your  wings to:
trailing a series of verdigris hoops trailing amber beads on their outer edges

A series of verdigris hoops trailing amber beads are tier 2 of 2.  They have access to the following verbs: flap, flip, flutter (afraid, annoyed, happy, scared), preen, remove, snap, stretch, touch, twitch, and wear.

1.  It must remain some kind of jewelry item and make sense for wings.

This is the Globus Elanthias scepter, or more commonly the Soul Eater scepter.  It has ghastly shadows as its flare type.  There is an skull made of obsidian that is wedged into the top of the length of kakore, and it can be customized in the following way:
Globe Type: Globe, Orb, Sphere, Spheroid, Ball, Skull
Globe Material: Glaesine, Glass, Crystalline, Obsidian, Clear Gemstone

An ornate kakore scepter etched with gnashing tormented souls can be altered with a long or a show description.  If it has a long description, then it will always have a show of "Firmly wedged at the top of the length of kakore is an obsidian skull."  However, if it does not have a show description, then it will always have a show of "Sinew and rawhide bind the top of the length of kakore to create a cradle for an obsidian skull that rests within it."  If you are designing your own show, you may ask your alterer to include how the skull is wedged into the scepter, but it must always be at the top.

An invar-bound carved boar tusk cannot store anything inside of it at all.
The tusk can be worn, attaching it to the belt.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of organic material, an extremely common material.
Analysis of an invar-bound carved boar tusk indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The Ale Festival Drinking Horn
Designed to store liquid and will hold a maximum of 20 sips, though some special containers are offered that are unlimited.
Verb Traps: CLOSE, DRINK, MEASURE, OPEN, REMOVE, TURN, POUR*, WEAR
* POUR - This verb works one-way, allowing you to fill the tusk.
Unlocks:
Any dwarven merchant may unlock this item and any Ale Festival Merchant may as well.
Alterations:

The noun must remain horn or tusk.  The overall design must remain dwarven in nature.  Bandings, tips, and ornaments made of common dwarven materials like invar, mithril, and glaes, are encouraged in their descriptions.  Dwarves also like gems; feel free to adorn them with all types of gemstones found across Elanthia when altering these items.  Mundane and magical creatures alike throughout Elanthia can be used for the primary material of these drinking vessels as long as they have large enough horns or tusks to drink from.  (e.g. minotaur horn, ox horn, vor'taz horn, tsark tusk, boar tusk).
Customizations:

Lid/Cap option requires a noun (ie: lid, cap, cover).  Tip/end is the referencing point of the lid and can be either material or a gemstone.  Ornament can be a design that is carved into the side of the tusk and will always start with "the" in the areas it is displayed.  Strap/chain is referenced when wearing the tusk and should include a noun.  It will always be preceded by "the."  Clasp/buckle is referenced when wearing and removing the tusk.  It is the method by which the tusk is held in place.  It is always preceeded by "its" or "the."  When altering the solemn toast, capitalize the sentence and do not use punctuation.
Customization Fields:
Lid/Cap: mistwood lid
Tip/End: invar-bound end
Ornament: dwarven emblem
Strap/Chain: strap
Clasp/buckle: clasp
Solemn Toast: To kin and kegs.
Cheerful Toast: (ONLY VISIBLE WITH UNLOCK) - May your barrels never run dry!
Special Dwarven Abilities:
* Ability to drink from the tusk while it is worn.
An invar-bound carved boar tusk is tier 1 of 2 tiers.
The carved boar tusk will cost 150,000 coins.
